name: St. Jude Rock 'n' Roll Nashville Half Marathon
typicalWeather: Average air temperature about 24 °C (75 °F), per the race site
summary: The St. Jude Rock 'n' Roll Nashville Half Marathon is part of the Rock 'n' Roll Running Series. It starts at 8th and Broadway and finishes at Nissan Stadium, past Broadway's honky-tonks, Music Row and the Country Music Hall of Fame. HalfRuns rates the course as rolling hills.
courseHighlights: Dolly Parton's recording studio on Music Row
Finish at Nissan Stadium, home of the Tennessee Titans

paceStrategy.summary: HalfRuns rates the course as rolling hills, and the race site gives no elevation figures. Run by effort on the rises, and keep a little in reserve for the second half.

segments.advice: Start at or just under goal pace and avoid surging in the crowd.

segments.terrain: Rolling streets through Music Row and other neighbourhoods
segments.advice: Run by effort and accept small changes in pace on the hills.

segments.terrain: Rolling road back toward Nissan Stadium
segments.advice: Keep the effort steady and speed up only in the last mile.

fuelingNotes: No aid-station positions were found on the pages we checked. The race site gives an average air temperature of 24 °C (75 °F), so plan to drink at every stop.
tips: Train on rolling hills, because HalfRuns rates this course as rolling
Plan for warm weather and drink early
Check the start and finish locations: the start is at 8th and Broadway and the finish is at Nissan Stadium
The race site says the course maps can change, so check the latest map before race day

faq.question: Is the Rock 'n' Roll Nashville Half Marathon flat?
faq.answer: No. HalfRuns rates it as rolling hills. We found no official elevation figures.

faq.question: Where does the Rock 'n' Roll Nashville Half Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at 8th Avenue and Broadway and finishes at Nissan Stadium.

faq.question: When is the Rock 'n' Roll Nashville Half Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is usually held on a Saturday in April.
